question:
The following bar graph shows the total number of newspaper readers (in thousands) in a city during 6 consecutive months in a particular year and the respective percentages of the above-mentioned readers who read Hindi newspapers. The rest of the readers read English newspapers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d6218d5970f386f61a565ded5a69647b45cd994cf83f91cca05142c40ff63f6.png] 

Note: Total readers = Hindi newspaper readers + English newspaper readers 

What is the difference between the number of Hindi newspaper readers during January, February and April taken together and that of English newspaper readers during March, May and June taken together?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total Hindi newspaper readers during January, February and April taken together = (65)/(100) × 140 + (70)/(100) × 150 + (90)/(100) × 75 

⇒ (13 × 7 + 7 × 15 + 3 × 45/2)

⇒ 91 + 105 + 67.5

⇒ 263.5
